Held under the “27th Night of Ramadan” initiative, part of the “Dafa’Al-Bala” campaign, it aimed to support and strengthen specialized healthcare services in Somalia. The closing ceremony was attended by HE Ambassador of the State of Qatar to the Federal Republic of Somalia Dr. Abdullah bin Salem Al Nuaimi. The campaign provided medical examinations and diagnostic assessments for 144 children with heart conditions and congenital heart defects. A total of 40 cardiac catheterization procedures were performed on children whose conditions required specialized treatment, under the supervision of a team of consultants and specialists in pediatric cardiology and cardiac catheterization. Speaking at the closing ceremony, Director of Qatar Charity’s Somalia Office Abdulfattah Adam Moallim said the campaign had exceeded its target of treating 35 cases by performing 40 cardiac catheterization procedures for children. This was a direct response to growing medical needs. He also announced that Qatar Charity is preparing to launch a specialized campaign for pediatric open-heart surgery before the end of the year. The campaign will address cases requiring advanced surgical interventions whose treatment needs could not be met through cardiac catheterization and heart defect repair campaigns. Partners and Doctors described the campaign’s success as a significant medical and humanitarian achievement, with Consultant in Pediatric Congenital Cardiology and Cardiac Catheterization at the Mogadishu Heart Center and Dean of the Faculty of Medicine and Surgery at Mogadishu University Dr. Mohamed Ahmed Mohamed affirming that the campaign’s results had given dozens of children a new chance at life and a more hopeful future. Consultant in Pediatric Cardiology and Cardiac Catheterization Dr. Iyad Al-Amouri praised the trust placed in the medical team by Somali families and the considerable efforts of young Somali medical professionals, whom he described as an important asset for the future of the country’s health sector. Qatar Charity previously carried out three specialized campaigns in Somalia to treat heart defects and conditions in children, benefiting 97 boys and girls. With the 40 cardiac catheterization procedures performed during the current campaign, the total number of children benefiting from therapeutic procedures and cardiac catheterization has risen to 137. By OMAR FARUK Associated Press November 1, 2026, 7:42 AM 1:24 FILE - Fishermen stand on the Indian Ocean beach at dusk in the former pirate village of Eyl, in Somalia's semiautonomous northeastern state of Puntland, Somalia, March 6, 2017. (AP Photo/Ben Curtis, File) The Associated Press MOGADISHU, Somalia -- MOGADISHU, Somalia (AP) — Somali pirates have seized an Iranian fishing vessel carrying 23 people, the Maritime Security Center Indian Ocean said, warning that the ship was approaching a commercial shipping lane and could become a floating base for further attacks. The Azini was hijacked Thursday between the coastal towns of Bandar Bayla and Hafun in northeastern Somalia, a maritime security officer with the Puntland Maritime Police Force said Sunday. The officer told The Associated Press that 12 pirates seized the vessel, which was carrying 21 Iranian crew members and two Somali security guards. He spoke on condition of anonymity because he wasn't authorized to speak with the media. The crew’s safety was unknown, the center said in an alert dated Saturday. In an updated warning, it said that pirates could use the vessel as a “mother ship” to support attacks on commercial vessels. The European Union’s naval Operation Atalanta was investigating. The center urged ships in the area to remain vigilant and report suspicious activity. The seizure follows a resurgence of Somali piracy across the Gulf of Aden and western Indian Ocean. By August, pirates had hijacked six commercial vessels since April , with some attacks taking place far from Somalia’s coastline. The captures included the oil products tanker Sibu 1, seized about 136 nautical miles (252 kilometers) east of al-Mukalla, Yemen. Attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and threats by Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthi rebels against Saudi-linked shipping through Bab el-Mandeb have complicated routes used to move oil to world markets. International naval patrols and improved maritime security sharply reduced Somali piracy over the past decade. Facebook Instagram X VKontakte Youtube Somali Guardian News Somalia Africa World Featured Editor Picks Editorials Home News Somalia Mawisley militias abandon front lines in central Somalia Mawisley militias abandon front lines in central Somalia November 1, 2026 Share Facebook X Pinterest WhatsApp MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Hawadle clan militias that fought Al Shabaab alongside government forces have abandoned front-line positions in Somalia’s central Hiran region, Caasimada Online news website reported on Sunday, as clan leaders push to form an administration independent of the federal government. The fighters, known as Macawisley, have left posts in the Mataban and Buulo Barde districts, and there are fears they could also quit Jalalaqsi town. Clan fighters seized control of the regional capital, Beledweyne, over the weekend, taking over the provincial headquarters and other government offices. About 2,000 heavily armed clan fighters are now in the town as part of a plan by Hawadle political figures to create an authority separate from Mogadishu and from Hirshabelle, the federal member state that includes Hiran. Fears of further defections There are concerns that Hawadle soldiers serving in the federal army in Hiran could also defect, a move that would leave the remaining government-held areas exposed to Al Shabaab. The insurgent group has retaken much of the ground gained by the militias and the army in 2022 and 2023, after a major counter-offensive in 2025. The Macawisley were formed in 2022 to fight Al Shabaab and received support from the federal government, Ethiopia and the United States. Abdullahi Mohamed Ali Sanbalolshe, a former head of the National Intelligence and Security Agency, said recently that they planned to set up an administration to confront the government in Hiran. He said it would ally with anyone, including Al Shabaab, to remove President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud. Dispute over Hirshabelle leadership Hawadle politicians say Mohamud promised their clan the Hirshabelle presidency, then reneged and sidelined them. They accuse the federal government of backing incumbent regional president Ali Gudlawe in a re-election vote that Mogadishu organised and whose outcome it controlled. It is unclear how the standoff will end or whether Mogadishu will send reinforcements to Hiran region. إلى منتخب قوي ومتجدد قادر على المنافسة وتحقيق الطموحات والإنجازات باسم الكرة البحرينية، واختيار المدرب سانشيز جاء بعد مراجعة شاملة لمسيرة المنتخب خلال السنوات العشر الماضية، وتقييم التجارب الفنية السابقة والاستفادة من ايجابياتها وسلبياتها». أضاف: «بعد الاطلاع على العديد من السير الذاتية للعديد من المدربين، وقع عليه الاختيار لما يملكه من خبرات فنية عالية». وتابع: «نبدأ مشروعا يمتد لأربع سنوات يستند إلى رؤية واضحة وبرنامج متكامل لتطوير المنتخب وتجديد صفوفه وإتاحة الفرصة للمواهب الشابة». ومن جهته قال سانشيز: «ندخل مرحلة جديدة مع المنتخب البحريني. لدينا حماس كبير ورغبة جادة في تحقيق الأهداف التي وضعناها لهذه المرحلة». وتابع: «نتطلع إلى تحقيق الأهداف بالعمل المشترك والتعاون مع جميع الأطراف، بما يخدم مصلحة المنتخب ويعزز فرص نجاح المشروع». وأكمل ابن الخمسين عاما: «متوافقون مع رؤى الاتحاد ومسؤوليه، وسنعمل بروح الفريق الواحد، ونحرص على اختيار أفضل العناصر لتمثيل المنتخب مع متابعة اللاعبين الواعدين والعناصر الشابة والوقوف على مستوياتهم وامكانياتهم الفنية». واستطرد: «هدفنا الظهور بالشكل الجيد في تصفيات كأس العالم المقبلة، والعمل سيبدأ من اليوم للوصول إلى أفضل حالة فنية. لدينا تحديات ومشروع مقبل، ونريد أن نبدأ رحلتنا معا». وقاد سانشيز منتخب قطر للظفر بكأس آسيا عام 2019 للمرة الأولى في تاريخه، بيد أن مشواره في مونديال 2022 في قطر انتهى مبكرا بثلاث خسارات في دور المجموعات، فأقيل بعد النهائيات عقب 5 سنوات في منصبه. تولى تدريب الإكوادور في مارس (آذار) 2023 وقاده إلى 10 انتصارات في 19 football.summary: يستعد فريق بيراميدز لخوض منافسات دور المجموعات في بطولة دوري أبطال أفريقيا، حيث حدد الاتحاد الأفريقي لكرة القدم "الكاف" مواعيد المباريات التي ستبدأ في 27 نوفمبر 2026. يقع بيراميدز في المجموعة الرابعة إلى جانب الهلال السوداني، حوريا الغيني، والمغرب الفاسي. ستقام الجولة الأولى بين بيراميدز والمغرب الفاسي في الفترة من 27 إلى 28 نوفمبر، تليها مباراة حوريا الغيني وبيراميدز في 4-5 ديسمبر. الجولة الثالثة ستجمع بيراميدز مع الهلال السوداني في 18-19 ديسمبر، بينما ستقام مباراة الإياب في 8-9 يناير 2027. الجولة الخامسة ستشهد مواجهة بيراميدز مع المغرب الفاسي في 15-16 يناير، وأخيرًا، ستقام المباراة السادسة بين بيراميدز وحوريا الغيني في 22-23 يناير. تأهل بيراميدز إلى دور المجموعات بعد الفوز على المريخ بينتو من جنوب السودان بمجموع 5-0.
